title: 535. Encode and Decode TinyURL

examples.explanation: decode(encode(url)) returns the original URL. The judge also checks that the short URL starts with http://tinyurl.com/, is stable across repeated encodes, and differs per distinct URL.
One shared Codec handles every URL in the test case: each encodes to its own short link and decodes back.
Encoding is idempotent: repeats of the same URL reuse the existing short link.

hints: Keep two maps on the Codec: long URL to code and code back to long URL, plus a counter that mints a fresh code for each unseen address.
Encode must be idempotent: an already-seen URL gets its existing short link instead of a new one.
Decode by stripping the http://tinyurl.com/ prefix and looking the code up in the reverse map.
